Surrounded by the Soc Son Mountains

overviewParagraphs: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort is located in the beautiful mountainous area of Soc Son, roughly an hour from Hanoi's city center. It holds the prestigious title of being the very first golf course in Vietnam designed by the legendary Nicklaus Design firm.

The defining feature of Legend Hill is its innovative "twin green" concept. Each of the 18 holes has been designed with two separate, completely different greens. This means that depending on the day's setup, the strategic puzzle of the hole changes entirely, offering a 36-hole experience within an 18-hole footprint.

The course is impeccably maintained, with lush Paspalum grass providing an excellent playing surface year-round. The impressive neoclassical clubhouse, which sits atop a hill overlooking the layout, adds to the grandeur of the experience, making Legend Hill a standout in Northern Vietnam.
curatorBriefHtml: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Hanoi, Vietnam, crafted by Nicklaus Design (2015) and stretching to 7,068 Yards across a mountain parkland environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its innovative twin-green routing concept (36 green variations on 18 holes) and pristine paspalum turf quality (Lush fairways and rapid greens).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie pin-placement accuracy (Well-versed in dual green sets), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Hanoi golf tour by AGS, BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort provides a distinct architectural test by Nicklaus Design that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: The first course in Vietnam designed by Nicklaus Design featuring a unique 'twin green' system that varies the pin angles and strategy every day. Impeccable turf and majestic mountain vistas.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort?
faqs.a: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort in Hanoi, Vietnam is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Nicklaus Design (opened 2015), measuring 7,068 Yards within a mountain parkland setting. It is particularly noted for innovative twin-green routing concept (36 green variations on 18 holes).

faqs.a: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie pin-placement accuracy (Well-versed in dual green sets)), and private VIP transfers from your Hanoi hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort's pristine paspalum turf quality (Lush fairways and rapid greens) alongside innovative twin-green routing concept (36 green variations on 18 holes). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort?
faqs.a: October through April is prime season for Northern Vietnam golf, offering cooler, drier conditions.
